<div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-left: 15px; padding-right: 15px;"><br/><div class="row"><div class="col-sm-6 col-sm-offset-3"><h2 class="title-text2 hidden-xs"> <span>Volt Makes Great Companies Better</span></h2>
<h2 class="title-text2 visible-xs" style="font-size: 20px;"> <span>Volt Makes Great Companies Better</span></h2>
<p align="left"><br/>Few things impact
your company’s success as much as the people and technology you rely on
every day: your employees, contingent staff, IT support, and outsourced
services providers. Volt offers consultative solutions to ensure you
have the qualified people you need, the processes to manage them
effectively, and an outsourcing partner you can count on to deliver.</p>
<p align="left">At Volt, we measure ourselves by the success of our
clients, so every service is tailored to give your business the
flexibility, agility, and insights to achieve great results. </p>
